role: A. actual RaidScene R-input method with declared receiver/state/host recorders

method.declaredReceiver: room (state/sessionId/reconnection/send recorder), predict (actual LocalPrediction; noteCast recorded; motion.orderPending overridden per declared pending state), rendered, input (declared pointer), cameras (declared camera), interp/clockSynced, slotView recorder, afterCast recorder, wishFx.predictCast recorder, slotCooldown (actual CooldownTracker), peek/frozenWorld/teleportAt/aimKnown
method.stubs: tools/wish-public-fixtures/stub-loader.mjs maps phaser to a declared minimal base-class module and every *.css to an empty module. No scene, DOM, keyboard, camera or renderer lifecycle runs.

declared.note: point-targeted cast at a visible enemy: the actual unit branch
slot ready exactly at serverNow
slot readyAt one ms in the future is a cooldown denial
declared wall column blocks line of sight (actual unitCastDenial/hasLineOfSight)
target beyond range + CAST_RANGE_SLACK
declared teleport immunity on the target
Trial unit cast, telegraph 350 ms
self-targeted cast with no cursor: aim falls back to the drawn self
self-targeted cast with the cursor over a ground point: the cursor point is sent
self-targeted instant Wish
point-targeted instant blink: actual blinkLanding and a longer pending wait
cursor on the caster: blinkLanding returns null -> Can't blink there
dead local fighter: slot model hidden, no send and no denial
stunned local fighter: blocked by the actual def.blockedBy rule
silenced local fighter
a previous cast with the same readyAt is still unanswered (actual castUnanswered)
the pending wait expired: the press is sent
planning phase freezes every order path
minimap peek with a non-self cast is suppressed
self cast still stands while peeking
unit cast with the cursor over empty ground: No target
unit cast with no cursor seen yet: No target
point cast with no cursor seen yet: Aim with the cursor
recent arena teleport: the actual inTeleportGrace check suppresses the press
a teleport well before the press does not suppress it
synced client clock: castSlot uses interp.clock.now for the server-time gates
training state is carried into the actual slot model
no slot view: castSlot returns before reading the cursor
reconnecting: the message is still produced; only the predicted telegraph is suppressed
the local fighter has no Wish for its faction: empty slot, no send
an EFFECT_HIDDEN target is not in the client candidate list: No target

sourceClosure.method: static import/export + dynamic load/import literal graph from the entry list plus engine.mts profile installers

externalPackages.phaser: replaced by tools/wish-public-fixtures/stub-loader.mjs: a declared base class only (RaidScene declares extends Phaser.Scene at module evaluation); no game, scene, renderer, DOM or keyboard runs
externalPackages.@colyseus/sdk: imported by packages/client/src/net/connection.ts; only sendInput's room.send recorder path is exercised

declared.note: Inputs/projection/host recorders are declared. Actual outputs are the unchanged source's return values, emitted events, emitted clocks and packed batches. No expected post-cast state is injected.
declared.clocks: performance.now() is a declared deterministic clock; no wall-clock value is captured.
declared.specials: Numeric specials are tagged ({tag:'NaN'|'+Inf'|'-Inf'|'-0'|'absent'}); a plain null is only a genuinely optional/absent field, never a valid zero.
declared.rInput: RaidScene.prototype.castSlot is called on a plain declared receiver; no keyboard, DOM, scene, camera or pointer proof is claimed.
declared.wishFx: WishFx.prototype.play/update are called with declared graphics/host recorders; method-level only, not a scene render.
declared.perceive: perceive() runs over declared source-schema-shaped projection rows and real packed batches; human WishFx output is a separate corpus and is not claimed to equal perceive.
